Breach Squad Privacy Policy

Effective November 8, 2026

Breach Squad is a game made for kids. It does not collect, store, share, or sell any personal information.

What the app collects

Nothing. The app has no accounts, no sign-in, no ads, no analytics, no tracking, and no in-app purchases. The Android app does not request internet access. It cannot send data anywhere.

What stays on the device

Your game progress (level, cash, and squad upgrades) is saved only on your own device so you can continue playing. It never leaves the device. Uninstalling the app, or choosing "Start over" in the game menu, deletes it.

Children's privacy

Because the app collects no personal information from anyone, it collects none from children under 13. This is consistent with the Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA).

Links and third parties

The app contains no links to websites and no third-party services.

Changes

If this policy ever changes, the new version will be posted on this page with a new effective date.

Contact

Questions? Open an issue at github.com/DusD24/IdleCombat/issues.
